name: uptop Self-Hosted Uptime Monitor
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted uptime monitor with HTTP, ping, TCP/port, DNS and push checks, SSH terminal dashboard, status pages, and alert integrations; no software usage quota or expiration stated.
watch_out: Bring your own server, storage, networking and notification providers; no free hosted compute or email delivery included. Requires SSH public-key admin setup; Docker ICMP checks need ping_group_range configuration. PostgreSQL recommended for production clustering.
